def unwrap_positions(trajectory, box):
    """
    Unwrap periodic boundary conditions to get continuous trajectories
    """
    timesteps = sorted(trajectory.keys())
    
    # Get box dimensions
    Lx = box[0][1] - box[0][0]
    Ly = box[1][1] - box[1][0]
    Lz = box[2][1] - box[2][0]
    L = np.array([Lx, Ly, Lz])
    
    # Initialize unwrapped positions with first timestep
    unwrapped = {}
    first_step = timesteps[0]
    unwrapped[first_step] = trajectory[first_step].copy()
    
    # Unwrap subsequent timesteps
    for i in range(1, len(timesteps)):
        prev_step = timesteps[i-1]
        curr_step = timesteps[i]
        
        # Calculate displacement
        displacement = trajectory[curr_step] - trajectory[prev_step]
        
        # Apply minimum image convention in reverse
        # If displacement > L/2, atom crossed boundary
        displacement = displacement - L * np.round(displacement / L)
        
        # Add to previous unwrapped position
        unwrapped[curr_step] = unwrapped[prev_step] + displacement
